title: MNT Reform 2 · dead 3.3 V rail
description: An open-hardware laptop mainboard (529 parts) that came back from a repair desk: it powers up, but the system never starts. The bench supply is clipped onto the gated input rail. Find out why the 3.3 V rail is missing, fix it, and leave the board clean.
credits: MNT Reform 2 motherboard rev 3.0, designed by MNT Research GmbH. Converted and modified (planted faults) for DEADBOARD.

title: Antmicro baseboard · no 3.3 V, flaky 5 V
description: An open-source carrier board for a compute module (392 parts), fed 12 V on VIN. The module will not start: 3.3 V is missing, and the customer says the 5 V rail "sometimes" drops out when the board is handled.
